contentText:
JOSHUA from SEVENTEEN takes Billboard to a fish market in South Korea and shares insights into his journey from L.A. to Korea, his passion for acoustic and indie music, viral performances and the strong bond within SEVENTEEN. He opens up about future plans in music production, dream collaborations and behind-the-scenes moments from the group’s latest tour.

JOSHUA: You have to try this with the wasabi.

Tetris Kelly: Wasabi is so hot.

It’s not that spicy.

You sure?

Yeah.

Only because you said so. I felt the wasabi instantly. 

You felt it?

That is so hot oh my gosh. 

I’m sorry!

Wait a minute!

Tetris!

Is that the prettiest man in South Korea even when it’s raining? How are you? 

I’m good! How are you?

I’m good! 

Where did you bring me today?

I love this place, it’s open 24/7, so you can come here any time of day, but I wanted to take you here because it’s, like, something special.

OK, I heard there’s a lot of wild things inside.

There’s a lot of wild things inside.

I’m nervous. I’m gonna eat them?

We’re gonna eat them today.

OK, well, show me what you got, Joshua. Let’s do this.

Let’s go, let’s go!

Are there multiple places like this in Korea? 

Well this is the place that I think is most famous around Seoul. People come here to just do casual drinking.

So you can drink out here, too. 

You can drink, hang out. So you pick the food from here and you go to a restaurant. There are restaurants that you could eat at. 

You just say, “Hey, Nemo, I want you.”

Yeah, basically for the prices I think it depends on the season, so like it might be more expensive this season.

Keep watching for more!
